newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 17.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Private sector can help boost health services, Riyadh governor says.
- Riyadh-based Advanced Electronics Co signs a licensing agreement with Tracor Aerospace to make and sell chaff and flare countermeasures.
- Second phase of an 838 million riyal Shoaibah water project in Jeddah will be completed by 1999.
- U.S. vote on Jerusalem to hurt Middle East peace process, King Fahd says.
- Trade exchanges between Saudi Arabia and India were worth 8,2 million riyals in 1995.
- Russian ambassador says Russia seeks more Saudi investments in Russian projects.
